independent exhaustive sign/ternary census and independent AGL(4,2) orbit traversal
correctness.rationale: The degree-two reduction is exact: source-lattice points are precisely feasible sign vectors, and every degree-two target is uniquely \(2q\) with \(q\in\{-1,0,1\}^{15}\). The carry-free base-three encoding converts decomposability into exact pair-sum membership. An independent implementation, written from the definitions rather than executing the repository verifier, exhaustively found 9552 feasible sign vectors, 6,350,363 feasible ternary targets, and 6,215,123 decomposable targets, hence exactly 135,240 holes. A separately implemented breadth-first action of the stated eight generators of \(\operatorname{AGL}(4,2)\) partitioned the hole set into orbit sizes 840, 13,440, 26,880, 40,320, and 53,760, summing to the full count. The algebraic action identity permutes the sixteen Walsh facet inequalities, so the orbit computation acts on the correct set.
